keywords.title: Topics
keywords.description: Keep requests that mention any of these words, e.g. finance, fintech, nutrition, SaaS, small business. Empty = every request.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude
excludeKeywords.description: Drop requests that mention any of these words, e.g. giveaway, sample, product review.

countries.title: SourceBottle countries
countries.description: SourceBottle lists call-outs per country. Empty = all six. Bluesky and Mastodon posts have no country.

maxAgeDays.title: Posted in the last N days

openOnly.title: Only open requests
openOnly.description: Drop requests whose deadline has passed (when a deadline is given).

includeProductRequests.title: Include product and giveaway requests
includeProductRequests.description: SourceBottle also lists requests for samples, prizes and gift-bag fillers. Off = expert and case-study requests only.

maxResults.title: Maximum requests
maxResults.description: Stop after this many requests, newest first.
